Membership Affairs Board shall have power to remove the
name of any person from the appropriate register-

(a)
if such person ceases to possess the qualification which
entitled him for registration; or

(b)

28.
(1)  It shall be lawful for the body corporate, from time
to time, at any general meeting and by the votes of not less than
two- thirds of the Professional Members present and voting, to
make  rules,  not  inconsistent  with  the  provisions  of  this  Act,
and any other written law for all or any of the following matters:-

(a)
classification  of  membership,  fees  payable  by  each
grade of members and procedure to be followed
in  the  admission,  withdrawal,  expulsion  or
resignation of members;

(b)
constitution  and  election  of  the  Council,  terms  of
office, resignation or removal from office or vacation
